title: Reduction-Ratio Experiment Brief: 1921 Lettering Treatise vs. Same-Size Drawing
purpose: A falsifiable experiment brief testing the treatise's claim that one-third reduction is "usual" for reproduction, against the alternative of drawing at same/near-same size. Provides a decision protocol and observable criteria for a practitioner replicating the hand-lettering workflow.
attribution: Source: Frank Chouteau Brown lettering treatise, eBook 20590, copyright line 1921, as documented in art_01M6QCDTKQ6Q9D5QFVA01NF6ZM revision 1. No content from the eBook is reproduced here; all references are to file line numbers reported in the Veyrul record.
